test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the correct word for the blanks in the given sentence.**

Health is a state of ______ being, and a ______ is used to draw water from the ground.
solution:
The correct answer is **"well."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **"Well being"** means a state of being healthy and happy. (स्‍वस्‍थ और प्रसन्‍न होने की स्थिति; कुशल-क्षेम, ख़ैरियत)

 
 
• **Example**: *Seeing her grandchildren gave her a sense of **well-being**__.*
 
 
 
• The sentence requires an adjective to describe the state of being healthy, and** "well"** is the appropriate choice.
 
• **"Well" **means a deep hole in the ground from which water is obtained. ((पानी का) कुआँ, कूप)
 __
 
• **Example:** *She asked me to draw water from the **well**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**:* **Health is a state of __**well**__ being, and a __**well**__ is used to draw water from the ground.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Tubewell: **a pipe with holes near the end, that is put deep into the ground to bring up water from under the ground by using a pump operated by hand. (किनारे पर छिद्रवाला पाइप जिसे ज़मीन के भीतर गहराई में रखा जाता है, तथा हस्तचालित पंप की सहायता से पानी खींचा जाता है; नलकूप)
 
• **Fine: **in good health, or happy and comfortable. (सुस्‍वस्‍थ या ख़ुश और आराम से)
 
• **Good: **of a high quality or standard. (उच्‍च गुणवत्ता या स्‍तर का, अच्‍छा)
